# OpenAlex search page (recorded)

`page-0.json` is the recorded structure of a REAL `GET /works` response (OpenAlex data is CC0),
truncated to the first 25 works in one page: `meta.count` is 25 and `meta.next_cursor` is null.
Email addresses in affiliation strings are replaced by the placeholder `example@example.org`;
everything else is as recorded. Used offline by `scripts/clean_install_scenario.py`.
